Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:111621
Court No. - 74
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 59588 of 2022

Applicant :- Shanker
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Bheshaj Puri,Amit Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed today on behalf of the State is taken on record.
2.  From the report of CJM dated 3.5.2023, it appears that notice has been served to the informant.
Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.

3. Heard Sri Bheshaj Puri, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S. B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State-respondent.
4.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
397 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC & 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Mahuli, District Sant Kabir Nagar, during pendency of the trial in the court below.
5. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant under sections 363, 366 IPC and according to the FIR, applicant has enticed away the daughter of the informant.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the entire allegation of enticement made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and applicant did not either enticed or abducted the daughter of the informant.

He further submitted that actually daughter of the informant is a major girl aged about 20 years and she according to her own wish had gone alongwith the applicant and Shanker vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49494909/
1 both performed marriage and started living as husband and wife and this fact is even evident from the statements of the victim recorded under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
7.

entities.text: Shanker vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submitted that as victim is an illiterate girl, therefore, there is no school record available for her age but according to the doctor, her radiological age is about 20 years and this fact clearly suggest that she is a major girl.
8. He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 8.10.2022, therefore, he may be released on bail.

9. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that victim in her both the statements recorded under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. did not make any allegation of rape against the applicant and her radiological age is about 20 years.
10.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. From the perusal of the statements of the victim record under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., it appears that victim according to her own wish had gone alongwith the applicant and had performed marriage with him and started living with him as his wife.
Even as per doctor, her radiological age is about 20 years.
12. Therefore, from the discussions made above, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
13. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

14. Let the applicant-Shanker, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
15. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
